scoreScale.2: Major defects; request is not usable without substantial recreation
scoreScale.3: Recognizable intent with material defects requiring normal editing
scoreScale.4: Meets the request with only minor correctable defects
scoreScale.5: Meets the request precisely with no material defect

invalidCandidatePolicy: Run deterministic engine validation first. Invalid candidates receive validation fields and failure categories but no visual or preference score.

dimensions.definition: Requested subject, palette, materials, details, and exclusions are represented without replacing the concept with a template.
Each content, style, palette, detail, and view reference influences only its declared role.
Atlas faces map to the correct head, torso, arm, and leg surfaces for the declared profile without mirroring, inversion, seams, or part swaps.
Identity, materials, continuing patterns, and asymmetric details agree across front, rear, sides, top, and bottom.
Pixel edges are deliberate and sharp; alpha, unused regions, layer boundaries, and low-contrast details remain correct.
Dense motifs and small details survive atlas normalization without becoming noise or losing requested structure.
The requested editable region changes as instructed while protected and immutable regions remain stable.
The normalized result has coherent semantic regions and can be refined with ordinary pixel tools rather than recreated.

preferenceProtocol.method: Blinded pairwise comparison among deterministically valid candidates with randomized left/right ordering
